works.title: Trump as Intransigent Actor: Game Theory Analysis
works.description: Substack post analyzing Trump's economic threats (credit card rate cap, Federal Reserve investigation) through a game theory lens, arguing he is an actor bent on institutional destruction rather than negotiation. Frames Trump as a transformative figure comparable to Andrew Jackson, waging economic war against Wall Street.
works.quote: The pasted material is the background and initial idea for an outline for a Substack post. I will add imagery portraying Donald Trump as embarking on a holy war channeling Andrew Jackson. My basic thesis is that Donald Trump has become an intransigent actor, not a negotiator.

works.title: Non-Woo Spiritual Practice
works.description: A practical manual on spiritual practice designed for skeptical, anti-mystical audiences. Teaches somatic literacy and embodied pattern recognition as trainable skills divorced from religious or New Age language. Articulates the underlying algorithm of intuitive practice through concrete, reproducible techniques.
works.quote: This is the kind of stuff that gets to the heart of a misconception I plan to address in a book on spiritual practice—because what we just outlined is a spiritual practice. But if you were to explain that to someone who's anti-woo and repelled by soft talk of intuition and knowing without conscious deliberation, you can bypass all that.
